items.title: SFL set for interstate showdown against Perth Football League
items.summary: The best players of the Sydney Football League (SFL) will take on the best of the Perth Football League (PFL) in a Representative AFL double-header in Perth next year

items.title: East Coast Eagles become Western GIANTS ahead of inaugural SFL season
items.summary: The East Coast Eagles will enter the inaugural Sydney Football League (SFL) season in 2027 as the Western GIANTS, marking a bold evolution for the foundation club

items.title: Henson Park's 2027 AAMI Community Series fixtures confirmed
items.summary: The AFL has confirmed the fixture for the 2027 AAMI Community Series, with two games to be played at Henson Park in Sydney's Inner West

items.title: Williamson to lead UNSW-ES into 2027
items.summary: Tom Williamson will continue as UNSW-ES Women’s SFL head coach in 2027

items.title: DUAL PREMIERSHIP SWAN JOINS BULLDOGS
items.summary: Swans great Ryan O’Keefe joins UNSW-ES as Director of Coaching

items.title: SFL partner with Premier Data ahead of inaugural 2027 season
items.summary: Premier Data has been announced as the Official Statistics, App and Performance Analysis partner of the Sydney Football League ahead of its inaugural season in 2027

items.title: Swans smash AFLW home crowd attendance record in 2026
items.summary: The Sydney Swans have recorded its highest-ever AFLW home attendance in one season, with 33,844 supporters flocking to Swans AFLW games in 2026

items.title: NSW/ACT draft hopefuls arrive in Melbourne for Draft Combine
items.summary: The 2026 Telstra AFL Draft Combine and 2026 Telstra AFLW Draft Combine will be hosted in Melbourne this week, bringing together the top prospects in this year’s Draft pools

items.title: 2026 AFL Sydney Phelan & Mostyn Medallists awarded
items.summary: The South West Sydney Blues’ Luke Parkinson and the North Shore Bombers’ Lucy Yates have claimed the Phelan and Mostyn Medals respectively for the 2026 AFL Sydney season

items.title: AFL Sydney product Rampe named stand-in Sydney Swans skipper
items.summary: Sydney Swans defender and AFL Sydney product Dane Rampe will lead the team for the remainder of the 2026 season, having today been named as the stand-in captain for Callum Mills

items.title: Swans Soar in front of record crowd at Sydney Derby V
items.summary: More than 7,340 fans packed Henson Park for the Sydney Derby as the Swans claimed bragging-rights over the GIANTS

items.title: Goals Galore in Dramatic Final Round Shoot-out
items.summary: Trent Dennis-Lane booted seventeen goals in the Wolves demolition of Inner West Magpies
